description: The pure pieces under the pdf ops: page layout, split plans, Ghostscript arguments, PNG row filters.

notes.text: A port of Ghostscript's @file reader (base/gsargs.c, arg_next, depth > 0), to check what it makes of our argfile.
Bits 1 and 2 must stay clear, 7 and 8 set.
Two rows of three grey pixels: 10 20 30 / 15 25 35.
